## CMsoft Import for TiaPortal

The TIA Portal project mirror in `TiaExport/` (program blocks as SimaticML `.xml`, `.scl`, `.s7dcl` / `.s7res`,
`.db`; PLC tags, data types, HW configuration). Full instructions, applied automatically:

- [instructions/tia-import.instructions.md](instructions/tia-import.instructions.md) — the file formats and their
  rules, the `tia_*` tools, the import → compile → fix loop; SimaticML schemas in `.github/Schemas/`;
- [instructions/tia-import-cli.instructions.md](instructions/tia-import-cli.instructions.md) — the MCP server and
  the CLI bridge (for scripts in `Tools/`).
